    |-- Pure synchronous parser shared by browser and server
    |-- Validate input and freeze policy
    |   |-- Defaults: mixed dialect; tree tolerance 1; wire tolerance 2;
    |   |   continuation auto; detached lists auto; conservative repairs
    |   |-- Compatibility profiles require tree dialect
    |   `-- Validate numeric limits; reject input exceeding maxChars
    |-- Pipeline: normalizeSource -> recognize -> interpretLayout -> interpretTrees -> interpretWires

    |   `-- Interpretation reports parserVersion = spatial-diagram-1

    |   |-- Original text + normalized rows + original offset pair for each normalized column

    |   |-- Edges: contains or references, decision ID, optional wire cells
    |   |   `-- A head meeting a branch can target its region instead of its item

        |-- Candidates + decisions with rule, reason, source evidence and repair references

|   |   |   |-- later operations see earlier staged edits

|   |   |-- finish layout, reconcile links, prune orphan metadata and normalize selection/views
|   |   `-- validate -> historyService.append -> publish controller snapshot -> notify listeners

|   |       `-- snapshot exposes version, checkpoint ID, canUndo and canRedo
|   |-- Operation families
|   |   |-- content: create, insert issued revision, patch, replace, apply revision
|   |   |-- composition: duplicate instance, move, group, collapse, remove, delete diagrams
